description.value:
Normalized Heritage. This item preserves the original UUID for Human (Erectus) while converting it from a lineage-species into a heritage.

“Humanity is the species that keeps walking even when the map says ‘stop.’”

Human (Erectus). You are not a fantasy human. You are the rebooted inheritance of an older lineage resurfacing after Yesod’s fall—ancient adaptations, forgotten instincts, and survival strategies given room to matter again.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid.
  • Size. Medium.
  • Speed. 30 feet.
  • Lineage Lean. Your lineage leans toward CON—expressed through Tier powers.

Core: Stubborn Spark

At creation you gain Stubborn Spark (Adaptive, Tenacious, Lineage Memory).

Erectus Tier Powers

You gain Tier I at creation, then Tier II (5), Tier III (11), Tier IV (17).

Note: This species uses placeholder ItemGrant UUIDs. Run the Human wiring macro after you store feats/species in compendiums.

advancement.title: Erectus Tier I
advancement.hint: Gain your Erectus Tier I lineage power.
